title: The Last Cipher
author: Kestrel Ashgrove
blurb: Ines Galloway, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
